The graphs represent the training progress through rewards over a number of steps for two different training sets, easy and hard, comparing two methods: "Llama-On-Policy" and "Llama-LUFFY." The x-axis is labeled "Steps" and ranges logarithmically from 0 to 500, with the tick label interval approximately every 100 steps.

The y-axis, labeled "Training Rewards," ranges from 0 to 0.4 for the easy training set and from 0 to 0.1 for the hard training set, with tick intervals not specified but consistent within each plot. In the easy training set, both methods seem to plateau after reaching their peak rewards, with "Llama-On-Policy" starting just below 0.2 and ending around 0.35, and "Llama-LUFFY" starting at approximately 0.15 and ending close to 0.4. In the hard training set, both methods exhibit more fluctuation, with "Llama-On-Policy" showing a sharp decline before stabilizing around 0.05 and "Llama-LUFFY" fluctuating mostly between 0.02 and 0.08.

The lines are color-coded with "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" in blue, "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" in red, "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" in teal, and "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" in black. The styles of the lines are also specified, with the exact nature of these not provided in the description.
